read_by: Agent-drafted, from the cell's own tier table, source register and decision log
input: Demand ratio 0 to 2, withheld above 2: arrays use event/design net pressure (fixed tilt) or tracker-normal gust / exact-system critical gust (tracker); site facilities use event/design wind pressure or a gust-squared proxy. The satellite-data module route uses event maximum gust, 17.4 to 39.1 m/s
not_covered: Replacement support (inspection, labour, rental, logistics, removal): no own curve; takes the value-weighted damage ratio of the other parts and is counted once
out_of_scope: Storm surge, flood, tornado and straight-line convective wind (separate pathways or cells)
Downtime, business interruption and insurance terms
Soft, sunk and non-physical cost (installed capex above physical replacement value)
missing_mechanisms: Windborne debris impact as a separately valued pathway

how_to_use.share_of: Replacement value of the same part; the plant view uses the named 2024-USD physical replacement profile, which must be requested and is never selected silently

outputs.single_event: conditional: needs the qualified architecture-specific demand input; trackers need exact-system qualification and attained stow state
outputs.scenario_dollars: conditional: needs the named value profile, a representative array exposure basis and a positive capacity_kwdc
outputs.yearly_loss: conditional: computed by the consumer after exact pin, frequency-intensity coupling, cap and value validation, and an explicit decision to accept screening grade

conditions: Array architecture is required and has no default; architectures are mutually exclusive
Commanded stow is not enough; trackers must prove attained state
Rain, debris, surge and tornado are excluded from this wind-only ratio and acknowledged separately
Unbridged 10 m gust, storm category or NHC sustained wind is rejected as input

method.summary: Ordered damage-state curves with Tier-4 synthetic resistance medians and cost ratios (cell-local decision, no direct TC calibration source); one module route fitted to NREL satellite storm-damage records

key_sources: NREL/NLR, Satellite Imagery of PV Site Storm Damage dataset, 2025 (TCWS-S020)
NREL, Q1-2025 Solar PV System Cost Benchmarks (TCWS-S013)
DOE/FEMP, Toward Solar PV Storm Resilience field investigation (TCWS-S004)
Cell owner decision on synthetic Tier-4 parameters (TCWS2_CELL_LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_DECISION)
judgment: Resistance medians and spreads for every array and facility curve are synthetic screening values
Damage-state cost ratios for every part are synthetic
The 0 to 2 demand range is a bounded synthetic domain; values above 2 are withheld
Satellite-data route assumes uniform module value and full replacement of every visibly damaged module
One representative array-zone curve is applied to the full array value

checks.name: Financial range check (Hazard repo): industry loss figures for solar hurricane

open_items: Tier-4 curves to be replaced by better evidence in a later model version
Wind-field, direction-history and duration-cycling bridge contracts are named but their external content is unresolved
Capability field status_before_promotion should become a clearer consumer-readiness field

rows.variants: architecture: fixed tilt / qualified single-axis tracker; resistance scenario: lower / central (headline) / upper

rows.shape_basis: Monotone fit to 34 satellite-labelled site records (source data T1, fit T3)
rows.cost_basis: Uniform module value and full replacement of visible damage assumed

notes.text: Source-compatible sites only; cannot be combined with the generic fixed-tilt module curve

rows.variants: architecture: fixed-tilt support structure / tracker structural BOS; resistance scenario: lower / central (headline) / upper
